issues.description: Method signature mismatch for messageOnMilk: the UML in the problem statement (interface Milkable) and the template/solution define messageOnMilk() with no parameters, but the textual Part 2 instructions in the problem statement require messageOnMilk(double milkVolume). This inconsistency (no-arg vs one double parameter) will confuse students which signature to implement and can cause compilation errors if students follow the textual instruction while the provided interface/solution expect no-arg.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the messageOnMilk method signature consistent across all artifacts. Recommended: update the textual Part 2 instruction in problem_statement.md to require messageOnMilk() with no parameters and adjust the example return text to omit the volume (e.g., "[Animal Type] [name] is milked"). Alternatively, if the volume parameter is intended, update the UML, the Milkable interface, all implementations (Seal, Goat) and any call sites (Main, tests) to messageOnMilk(double milkVolume) and change example return strings to include the volume. Prefer the first option to match the current template and solution.
